calibrationNote: Unchanged at 8.5; detail mean 8.32 (w50 8.33). The change does what the code says: the roll fronts are now 1.9-2.9 cm behind the cover at every height. But it didn't move the q17 measurement. The near cover blob is 3801 px (w50 3980, photo 6961) with the same bbox (x633-732 y162-250 against 633-733 161-250). The lateral studio render shows why: my w50a-1 mechanism was wrong. The rolls never stood in front of the flap. The flap (now 0.21 wide, edges at +-0.105) sits in a 2.3 cm gap inside the rolls (inner faces at +-0.128), and from the q17 angle the 11 cm deep roll shows its whole front and inner flank beside the flap's edge. In y_47306 and y_47303 the flap is wider than the gap between the rolls and lies over their inner halves; its foot also hangs lower (q17 foot 250 against 299). Narrowing the cover by 1 cm moved q17 slightly the wrong way. In q15 the 1 cm lift helped the top (247-249 against 250-252; photo 241-245), but the foot rose more (287-289 against 296; photo 289-292). The head-on flap is now slightly short: h 39-43 against 46-52, h/w 0.56-0.62 against the photo's 0.60-0.74, and cover-to-headrest width 0.56 against the photo's ~0.60. These roughly cancel. Headrest 8.2 -> 8.15. Nothing else moved: e6, e7, e8, e10 and e11 are pixel-identical, and the other diffs lie only in the headrest and back-top regions.
